assessment: Strict recursive duplicate-key/depth validation runs before serde_json Value conversion. Every typed frame rejects missing/unknown/coerced structural fields; accepted_pending rejects result/committed/error additions. Fixed error vocabulary does not expose payload strings.

Event/control handshakes have distinct schemas. Operation vocabulary contains no native approval operation. Control requires explicit grant, local authorizer identity, negotiated operation, current usable capability and stateful expected revision. Same-UID arbitrary code is explicitly outside socket isolation guarantees.

Registry/session Rc identities prevent cross-instance authority reuse; per-generation scope invalidates old sessions. Reconciliation issues manager-owned random v4 UUIDs using bounded nonblocking OS entropy; wire callers cannot choose a former generation.

Admitted sequence advancement occurs only after queue and independent receipt-count/byte capacity checks. Reused EventId/conflicting sequence/gaps fail closed, bounded receipt exhaustion freezes acceptance rather than forgetting replay protection. Fair per-producer queue state remains in its own module.

Pure schema modules do not import IPC/storage/adapters/QML; ingestion imports narrow protocol and connection evidence and delegates queue/entropy responsibilities. There is no durable acknowledgment, persistence actor, reducer or runtime executor disguised as completed functionality.

14 focused schema/roundtrip/boundary tests share metadata builders; separate fuzz workload already has its own module. No production implementation is duplicated.
Shared disposable peer and metadata builders plus focused admission/recovery/cross-boundary tests; distinct control and resource-limit scenarios are already in cohesive sibling test modules.

limitations: Review is not merge approval, complete M1 acceptance, native namespace qualification, Docker qualification or paired execution attestation. Owner approval and final exact-revision qualification remain mandatory.

Generation restoration/current-turn/process identity proof and atomic durable replay retirement remain explicit #9/#10 integration obligations; this issue only supplies volatile admission and typed requests.
No production adapter persistence path is enabled. Opaque accepted strings do not prove absence of private content; source-mapping provenance and persistence canaries remain future adapter gates.
